mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy remains accommodative.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A falling unemployment rate below 8.5% signals labor market strength that increases consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE falls below 8.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts and retail sales (both above 3-month moving averages) indicates robust consumer demand, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS exceed their 3-month moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production above 100.5 during expansionary phases signals economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO exceeds 100.5 during expansionary phases.

mechanism_narrative: A rising retail sales series (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer spending that precedes corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when RSAFS shows sequential growth.

mechanism_narrative: CPI index exceeding 222.0 signals inflationary pressure that triggers anticipated monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 222.0.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent employment growth (PAYEMS above 3-month average) and unemployment decline (UNRATE below 3-month average) indicate labor market tightness, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS exceeds its 3-month moving average and UNRATE falls below its 3-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 94.0 signals manufacturing contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as economic activity weakens.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO falls below 94.0.
